synth.final_message:
`python3 check.py` prints ALL PASS (19/19 transitions).

The rule in `program.py`:

| Action | Effect |
|---|---|
| 3 | The cursor goes to the previous editable glyph slot (x = 15, 22, 29, 36, 43). From the first slot, it goes to the last slot. |
| 4 | The cursor goes to the next slot. From the last slot, it goes to the first slot. |
| 1, 2 | No extracted field changes. |

Unconfirmed hypothesis: actions 1 and 2 probably cycle the letter of the selected glyph. The extractor does not give pixels, so the data cannot show this.

The data has no observations for click (6) and actions 5 and 7. The program returns the state unchanged for these actions.
